title: Numbers from 100 to 1,000
subtitle: Hundreds and thousands
review: Written by Claude, modelled on the French fundamentals. Check the IPA (British) and any Burmese before using it with learners. No audio yet: record with `audio.py words`.

groups.title: The hundreds
notes: British English says and after hundred: one hundred and ten. American English often leaves it out.
No s on hundred after a number: two hundred, not two hundreds.
You can also say a hundred for one hundred.

groups.title: Bigger numbers
notes: English writes a comma in big numbers: 1,000 and 10,000.
